content.text: Hnopai moikapap hlak hai minhawinae heh rawi hanelah ao,
tangka hoi sui hlak hai ayâ ni pahrennae heh
ngaihnawn hanelah ao.
Tami ka tawnta hoi tamimathoe rei a tawn roi e teh,
BAWIPA teh bangpueng kasakkung doeh.
Kâhruetcuet e ni teh hnokathout a hmu navah a kâhro,
hatei kamawngrame ni teh a ceisin teh rek e lah ouk ao.
Kârahnoumnae hoi BAWIPA takinae ni tawntanae hoi
barinae hoi hringnae a tâcokhai.
Lam longkawi dawk teh pâkhing hoi karap ao teh,
a hringnae lamthung ka ring e teh
hotnaw hoi ahlanae koe doeh ao.
Camo ni a dawn hane lamthung pâtu haw,
a matawng to hai phen mahoeh toe.
Tami ka tawnta ni tamimathoe a uk,
ka câwi e tami teh kacâwisakkung koe san lah ao.
Payonpakainae cati ka tu e ni lungmathoenae a a vaiteh,
a lungkhueknae sonron a khoe han.
Pahrennae mit ka tawn e teh yawhawi a coe han,
bangkongtetpawiteh tamimathoenaw ouk a kawk toe.
Dudamnaw pâlei haw kâounnae tang a roum han,
kâyuenae hoi kâpakungnae hai a roum han.
A lungthin ka thoung e teh,
kamcu e lawk a dei dawkvah
siangpahrang e hui kahawicalah ao han.
BAWIPA mit ni panuenae a kountouk,
hatei yuemnae ka tawn hoeh e lawk teh ouk a takhoe.
Ka pangak e tami ni alawilah sendek ao,
lam vah na kei han doeh, ouk a ti.
Napui kahawihoehe pahni teh kadunge tangkom doeh,
BAWIPA ni a panuet e teh hawvah a bo han.
Pathunae heh camo lungthin dawk a kâbet teh,
yuenae bongpai ni ahlanae koe ouk a pâlei.
Ma mek nahanelah tamimathoenaw ka rektap e hoi,
katawntanaw ka poe e tami teh hoehoe a mathoe han.
Tamilungkaangnaw e lawk heh kahawicalah thai nateh,
na lungthin hoi kaie lungangnae hah dâw haw.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, na thung hoi na pâkuem pawiteh
hothateh lunghawinae doeh, na pahni dawk pou awm seh.
Hottelahoi BAWIPA teh na kâuep thai han,
sahnin vah nang koe na panuesak toe.
Kâpankhainae hoi panuenae kahawi poung e hah
na thut pouh toe nahoehmaw.
Nang ni lawkkatang katang na panue vaiteh,
nang koe patoun e naw hah lawkkatang lawk
bout na dei pouh thai han.
Mathoenaw e mathoenae hah thakâla hoi
ahnie hno lawm hanh, ka cunathoehnaw hai
kho longkha koe coungroe hanh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, BAWIPA ni ahnimae kong a pouk han doeh,
ahnimae hno kalawmnaw e hringnae a lawp pouh van han.
A lungkaduem e tami hah kamyawngkhai hanh,
a lungkhuek thai poung e tami hai kamyawngkhai hanh.
Ahnimae nuen na kamtu vaiteh,
na hringnae a kâman han.
Kut tambei e taminaw hoi laiba patho pouh hanelah
lawk kâkam e taminaw koe bawk van hanh.
Patho nahane na tawn hoeh pawiteh,
na ikhun tawm awh vaiteh oun na la pouh awh han nahoehmaw.
Na mintoenaw ni ung e
khori hah takhoe hanh.
Thaw kahawicalah ka tawk ni teh ka cuem e na hmu boi ou,
siangpahrangnaw hmalah hai a kangdue han doeh,
tami rumram e hmalah kangdout mahoeh.
